text:
maya: quick update - onboarding Salient-7B-fork into our eval harness. conversion + int4 quant finished but conv-QA EM dropped ~5.6% vs our fp16 baseline.
sam: can you paste the exact convert/quant commands and any warnings? :eyes: 
maya: ran:
````
python tools/convert_salient.py --src models/salient_fp16/ --dst builds/salient_salfmt/ --emit-tokenmap
python tools/quantize.py --model builds/salient_salfmt/ --dtype int4 --block-size 64 --calibrate 4096 --rotary-auto
````
Convert printed: `WARN tokenizer mismatch: reported vocab 50256 != expected 50272 -> sentinel/pad tokens present`.
joel: classic token id shadowing. If embedding indices moved but runtime assumes old ids, KV cache and attention rotary associations will be wrong. Did loader apply tokenmap.json?
maya: tokenmap.json + tokenmap.txt were emitted, but loader didn't because model.meta had `vocab_equivalent: true`. So no remap applied at load time.
anya: also note the pretrained config uses `rotary_scale: 0.68` (fractional). Converter defaulted to 1.0. Combined with int4 small quantization noise, phase offsets amplify on longer contexts.
sam: quick experiment plan: 1) fp16 roundtrip with tokenmap applied 2) int4 with tokenmap applied 3) int4 + hybrid-emb (keep embedding table fp16) 4) int4 + rotary_scale forced to 0.68. Keep batch=1, eval set=conv-QA-5k.
maya: ran small sweep (1k samples) on staging:
````
1) roundtrip+remap fp16: EM=94.1 (fp16 baseline 95.0), p95 latency=120ms
2) remap + int4: EM=90.0, latency=52ms
3) int4 + hybrid-emb(fp16): EM=92.9, latency=57ms
4) int4 + rotary=0.68: EM=89.6, latency=52ms
````
So tokenmap remap recovers most of the gap; hybrid embeddings give additional gain. Rotary tweak alone is insufficient.
joel: confirms hypothesis: majority of regression is vocab->embedding misalignment. Hybrid embedding is a strong mitigation.
anya: operational actions: - make convert fail when vocab size differs unless `--apply-tokenmap` is explicitly passed - runtime loader should prefer applying tokenmap if present or at least emit loud warning and a `--force-remap` flag - quantizer should expose `--hybrid-emb` and document perf/quality tradeoffs
sam: also add an integration test: take N random token ids, convert->remap->load and assert embedding_lookup(token_id) equals embedding_lookup(remapped_token_id) within tol. That would catch shadowing early.
maya: created PR with enforcement + unit that samples 2048 tokens and asserts exact equality after remap (https://rwd/pr/1302). I also added a small diagnostic CLI `rwd-tools sample-token-shadow --model builds/salient_salfmt/` that prints any token ids whose slot changed.
ci-bot: salient-7b-int4-remap build pushed to staging: tag=salient-7b-int4-remap-2026-03-24
sam: can we run a long-context (2048) regression overnight on remap+hybrid-emb build? previously we saw drift around 1k.
maya: scheduled the 2k run tonight. If KV cache checks out we'll mark remap+hybrid as the onboarding default for this fork.
joel: small doc item: add to model-onboarding checklist an explicit step "verify tokenmap application + embedding slot parity" and include the diagnostic snippet for support.
anya: release-note suggestion: "Salient-7B (community fork): conversion requires explicit tokenmap remap to avoid embedding index shadowing; int4 users recommended to enable hybrid embeddings to reduce QA regressions."
maya: thanks all - will post full longctx metrics and PR link once CI finishes. :thumbsup:
